source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Project Timeline - Six weeks
Milestone - 1350 USD

The second milestone covers:
1\. Complete the Meet Alfred set up
2\. Create and configure a Zapier account
3\. Using Zap, connect Hubspot with Meet Alfred
4\. Create a Domain, then Warm it up
5\. Configure an automated LinkedIn Campaign in Meet Alfred
6\. Configure an automated Email Campaign in Meet Alfred
7\. Map the data flow running from Meet Alfred to Hubspot
8\. Build a Lead Management System in Hubspot
9\. Produce different types of reporting

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The selected plan is Pro, with no add ons included.

routing_warnings.description: The test concerns synchronization after aligning campaign and list names across HubSpot, MeetAlfred, and Zapier, not the general Zapier account or plan.
The observed contact-upload failure concerns the lead-synchronization flow rather than Zapier platform configuration.
The instructions describe creating a new MeetAlfred campaign by duplicating and renaming an existing Zap, not general Zapier platform setup.
The zero-lead observation after publishing the duplicated Zap is a runtime outcome for lead synchronization, not the Zapier account or subscription configuration.
